notes: Taifa of Dénia, 1010-1076 and 1224-1227, one dossier. Page budget 5; nine pages opened because Cliopatria's later Dénia rows (1066-1125, 1147-1151, 1236-1249) are not what the Dénia page describes and needed the Majorca, Valencia, Almizra, Dénia-town and Kingdom of Valencia pages. UNSETTLED: (1) Cliopatria draws Dénia 1066-1125, 1147-1151 and 1236-1249; the taifa article has no state in those years. The 1066 shape is cut at 1076; the 1147-1151 and 1236-1249 shapes are marked wrong. The LAND of the last two (south-east Murcia/Alicante in 1147-1151; the Dénia-Alicante-Orihuela belt in 1236-1249) then has no owner in any dossier of this batch: the taifa-of-murcia, taifa-of-valencia, crown-of-aragon and crown-of-castile dossiers (other eu-12 parts) should claim it, or the map will have holes. (2) The end of the state is 1227 on the taifa article, but the Dénia town page has the town conquered by the Christians in 1244, the Xàtiva page has Xàtiva captured in 1244 and the Kingdom of Valencia page lists Denia among the taifas wiped out in the conquest; the 1227 date is kept for the state. (3) 1050 autonomy (Dénia page) and 1076 independence (Majorca page) of the Balearics: entered as a client tint 1050-1075 then loss. (4) After 1076 the land went to Zaragoza (1076-1081), Tortosa (1081-1092) and the Almoravids (1092-1224) on the infobox; the town page says Zaragoza until the Almoravid invasion of 1091. (5) Murcia, Lorca, Orihuela and Elche were taken 'extending his power to the Segura River' without dates; no event entered. (6) Sardinian counterparts: giudicato-of-logudoro and giudicato-of-gallura (fix pass); the page does not name a judicate. Needs dossiers: Taifa of Majorca (1076-1116, 1147-1203, slug taifa-of-majorca). (7) Every Cliopatria Dénia shape (1010, 1015, 1040, 1066) misses the town of Dénia itself, so a 20 km district is added in the corrections and the found event. Gazetteer names used that it lacks: Dénia, Xàtiva, Alzira (places). FIX PASS 2026-10-25 (author, after the reviewer's FAIL): (a) The Sardinian occupation is now two pairs of events, counterparts giudicato-of-logudoro (12 cells) and giudicato-of-gallura (2 cells), region the north of the island only (Sardinia within Cliopatria's two judicates of 1015, 14 cells, about 3,500 km2), not the whole island (83 cells); the war's zone and belligerents and the 1015 keyframe note are corrected.
